## About
I'm an IT student, software developer and freelance designer based in Jaipur, India. I enjoy building modern web applications, experimenting with artificial intelligence, designing intuitive interfaces and working on real-world client projects.

## Services
- **Web Development**: Responsive websites, web applications and business software such as CRM tools, built end to end.
- **AI & Automation**: AI-powered applications and automated workflows for businesses.
- **UI/UX Design**: User flows, wireframes, interface design and interactive prototypes.
- **Graphic Design**: Social media creatives, branding and visual communication for clients.
